prompt:
Create a high-fidelity OmniGear KEYBOARD 'Teclas' remapping UI design comparison. Use attached approved mouse Botões screen ONLY for visual identity: exact OmniGear header, clean sans type, neutral monochrome palette, sidebar and footer materials. Replace the mouse and all mouse controls with keyboard-specific content. Output a square board containing TWO equal complete desktop landscape viewports stacked vertically: dark above, light below, same layout and physical keyboard across both themes. Crisp Brazilian Portuguese, no exterior title or browser frame.
Header 'OmniGear' + 'Demonstração' badge, ONE moon outline icon top-right in dark, ONE sun outline icon top-right in light; no switch or simultaneous pair. Sidebar20% width: '← Dispositivos', 'Teclado de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown. ONLY nav items 'Teclas' SELECTED, 'Iluminação', 'Perfis', 'Geral'. No mouse DPI, performance or parameters menu.
Main title 'Teclas', subtitle 'Selecione uma tecla e escolha sua função.'
Subject: realistic clean top-down compact ANSI 65% mechanical keyboard, matte black case/keycaps and light readable key legends; accurate familiar five-row QWERTY layout with number row, Tab/QWERTY row, Caps Lock/ASDF row, Shift/ZXCV row, Ctrl/Win/Alt/spacebar bottom row and arrow cluster at right. No RGB, decorative wallpaper, wire spaghetti or brand logos. Keyboard depicted SAME black object in both themes. Caps Lock is SELECTED with contrasting white outline; physical key legend remains Caps Lock, current assigned function in editor is 'Ctrl esquerdo'. Do not highlight letter A instead. One changed key only.
Editor content: title 'Caps Lock', small label 'Tecla selecionada', field label 'Ação atribuída', dropdown 'Ctrl esquerdo', concise help 'Funciona como a tecla Ctrl da esquerda.', quiet action 'Restaurar tecla'. Correctly distinguish physical key from assigned action.
Common main bottom footer: '1 alteração não salva', secondary 'Descartar', primary 'Salvar no perfil'. White primary in dark, black primary in light. No macros, magnetic actuation, rapid trigger, layers, calibration, testing panel or additional unrequested keyboard features. Airy working configurator UI.
OPTION1: Large keyboard centered horizontally in main body below title, around80% of main width. Leave generous space UNDER it. A small contextual editor popover BELOW keyboard's LEFT third connected by a thin elbow leader to Caps Lock at left of home row. Popover compact horizontal or modest rectangular layout with CapsLock heading, assigned action dropdown, helper and Restaurar tecla; do not cover any physical keys. Single clear selected-key outline and one leader line only. Keyboard and nearby editor dominate. Footer unchanged. This is direct contextual editing matching user's selected mouse composition.
title: Edição junto à tecla
description: Teclado centralizado, com editor conectado à tecla selecionada.
notes: Keyboard geometry and legends are illustrative; implementation must render accurate model-specific semantic key hit areas and legends. Physical Caps Lock maps to left Ctrl in this demo draft. No layers, macros or Hall-effect settings are included.
